newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures close higher, still rangebound.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures close higher, still rangebound.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures corrected recent losses and closed firmer, but market sources expect prices to continue their descent in the near term.

"We have failed to pick up any upside momentum," Celeste Georgakis, vice president with Dean Witter, said. "The fundamentals are still bearish and lacking any new developments as we enter delivery period."
Support basis May was pegged at the recent low of 72.10 cents hit on April 9, and longer-term support cited at 65.50 cents, a low made in 1993.
Most-active July closed 0.50 cent a lb firmer at 77.80 cents per lb, having traded from 77.90 to 76.80 cents. May finished 1.15 cents higher at 75.70 cents.
Estimated turnover was 4,000 lots compared with Monday's official 4,619 lots.
The spec/hedge report released early today revealed that the speculators added to their short positions, bringing their short position for the week to 35.9 percent from 32.7 percent.
